channel.title: Context Engineering on MJ's Blog
channel.description: Recent content in Context Engineering on MJ's Blog

item.title: Anthropic Just Ate My Startup
item.description: I built an iOS app to bridge Apple Health data to AI. Two weeks later, Anthropic shipped the same feature natively. Here's what I learned about building in the AI era.

item.title: I'm Quitting Claude (But Not What You Think)
item.description: After losing six months of Claude context to an account reset, I rebuilt my AI workflow on local files. Here's why context ownership matters more than convenience.

item.title: Why I Had to Rewrite My MCP Server from Python to TypeScript
item.description: I tried deploying a Python MCP server to Cloudflare Workers. It didn't work. Here's what I learned about remote MCP deployment.

item.title: The Manus Paradox: What the Fastest-Growing AI Company Reveals About Agentic AI
item.description: Manus went from zero to $100M ARR in 8 months—then got cloned in 3 hours. What this paradox reveals about where value actually lies in autonomous AI agents.

item.title: I Vibe Coded an AI App — But There's No AI Inside
item.description: I spent two Saturdays building an iOS app with 98% AI-generated code. It exports running data for AI analysis and generates art prompts — but has zero AI features itself. Here's why that's the point.

item.title: From Two Subscriptions to One Weekend Build: The AI Architecture Pattern Everyone's Missing
item.description: I spent a weekend building what I was paying $200/year for. Here's what I learned about AI architecture—MCP, Skills, Subagents, and Prompts—and why context window is sacred.

item.title: Context Engineering Lessons from Building Manus
item.description: Key insights from Manus's experience building AI agents - why context engineering has become the critical skill for 2025

item.title: The AI Honeymoon Period: What Context Engineering Taught Me About Hype vs Reality
item.description: A Twitter debate about AI's transformative potential reveals the gap between honeymoon-period optimism and measured reality. Why agile methodology and product managers might be the real winners in this AI transition.

item.title: The AI Productivity Paradox: Why Curiosity Beats Role
item.description: Why some people see massive AI productivity gains while others don't—and what I discovered about my own motivation when I tried to understand the difference.

item.title: The Best Interview Question for AI Product Managers
item.description: Why asking 'Show me your best prompt' reveals everything about an AI product manager's competency - and how to evaluate their answers.

item.title: Why Can't LLMs Say 'I Don't Know'?
item.description: A deep dive into why AI models struggle with uncertainty, what Anthropic discovered about hallucination mechanisms, and practical strategies for reducing AI hallucinations in both personal and enterprise contexts.

item.title: Three Months Later: From Prompt Engineering to Context Engineering (And Why I've Been Doing It With Humans All Along)
item.description: A three-month reflection on AI developments, the shift from prompt to context engineering, and how Product Management taught me to debug human communication.
